verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Cal.com offers React "atoms" for adding scheduling to your own app (cal-com-docs-36, cal-com-docs-10, cal-com-docs-54), plus a Framer app integration (cal-com-intdir-14), so in-site embedding is possible. However, atoms depend on creating "managed users" through the Platform flow (cal-com-docs-57), and nothing in the pack documents the inline, popup or floating widget modes or a copy-paste embed snippet. Missing for 10: documented inline/popup/floating embed modes, a documented embed snippet, independent hands-on corroboration of embedding.
